Moxie Patel: Hi! I'm Moxie (she/they). Starting today on Eng Platform — excited to meet folks. Bringing a sourdough loaf to the rooftop tomorrow ~11:30 if anyone wants a slice. Also: socks or sandals? :socks: :sandals:
Harper Lin: welcome!! i'll be there for a slice :raised_hands:
Eli Navarro: socks forever. also what's your badge color? :badge:
Moxie Patel: lavender — badge #4072. not a code snippet but here's my go-to toast: `ricotta + lemon zest + honey` if anyone wants a demo.
Zoe Martinez: sandal gang here 👡 (but i'll take bread)
Arjun: socks. trade coffee for slice? ☕️
Noor Khalid: welcome!! rooftop at 11:30 works for me :sun_with_face:
WelcomeBot: New hire Moxie Patel added to #new-hires. Onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood/1st-day
Harper Lin: quick poll — desk plant or lamp? :seedling: vs :bulb:
Moxie Patel: lamp for sure, plants hate me 😅
Eli Navarro: reaction :socks: on the poll (3)
Harper Lin: OG loaf photo? pls :camera_with_flash:
Moxie Patel: will post tomorrow morning. also open to toast topping suggestions!
Arjun: everything bagel seasoning + butter is underrated
Zoe Martinez: jam squad :strawberry:
Noor Khalid: welcome again, Moxie! see you tomorrow :wave:
